description: Seven fixed random voltages, drawn again on command

params.text: Draws a new voltage for every output

inputs.text: A trigger draws a new voltage for every output

outputs.text: One of the seven random voltages, held until the next draw; each output gets a different value

notes: the values are saved with the patch, so a reloaded patch sounds the same until a new set is drawn
menu: Random range — sets the span the new values are drawn from: 0V to 10V, 0V to 5V, 0V to 1V, -10V to 10V, -5V to 5V or -1V to 1V
